evidence.documentation: The horiztonal beamlet divergence of the component. Here the divergence is defined for Gaussian beams as the angel where the beam density is reduced by a factor 1/e compared to the maximum density. For non-Gaussian beams the divergence is sqrt(2)*mean((x-mean(x))**2), where x is the angle and the mean should be performed over the beam density, P(x): mean(y)=int(y*P(x)*dx).

evidence.recorded_refusal: missing physical_base vocabulary token 'plateau_factor': The quantity is the dimensionless 'plateau factor' defined by Stroth et al. (1998) equation (25), a flattening measure of the local profile at the stellarator effective minor radius r_eff_norm = 2/3. The needed base token is not registered: the only generic candidates (bare `factor`, `parameter`) are contentless whole bases that the audit rejects, and the registered `peaking_factor` denotes the opposite profile shape, so it cannot be substituted without changing the observable. The distinguishing qualifier `plateau` is also not (and will not be) a registered qualifier. The stellarator r_eff_norm locus likewise has no registered token (`normalized_minor_radius` is a tokamak minor-radius normalization, not the effective minor radius normalized to its last-closed-flux-surface value). A faithful standard name therefore requires a new base vocabulary entry rather than a near-synonym; the referenced definition should be retained as metadata.

evidence.recorded_refusal: missing qualifier vocabulary token 'tangency': The quantity is the tangency radius of individual neutral-beam beamlets. evidence.parent_documentation: Tangency radius (major radius where the central line of a NBI unit is tangent to a circle around the torus)
evidence.recorded_refusal: missing qualifier vocabulary token 'tangency': The quantity is the tangency radius of a neutral beam unit: the major radius at which the beam centreline is tangent to a toroidal circle (the perpendicular distance from the symmetry axis to the beam line), an intrinsic injection-geometry parameter distinct from the injector's position. The geometry is expressible as qualifier 'major' + base 'radius', but no registered qualifier token ('tangency'/'tangent') exists to mark the tangency carrier. The nearest expressible names — 'major_radius_of_neutral_beam_injector' or 'radius_of_neutral_beam_injector' — denote the injector's own location or ion-source aperture (existing 'radial_coordinate_of_neutral_beam_injector', 'radius_of_neutral_beam_injector') and therefore a different observable, while the existing sibling 'perturbed_major_radius' covers only the tilting-induced variation (nbi/unit/beamlets_group/tilting/delta_tangency_radius). Registering a 'tangency' geometric qualifier (or a 'tangency_radius' base) would let all three NBI members — nbi/unit/beamlets_group/tangency_radius, nbi/unit/beamlets_group/beamlets/tangency_radii and this summary leaf — share one faithful standard name.

evidence.documentation: Value
evidence.parent_documentation: Radiated power from the plasma outside the Last Closed Flux Surface
evidence.recorded_refusal: missing region vocabulary token 'outside_last_closed_flux_surface': The quantity is the radiated power over the plasma region OUTSIDE the last closed flux surface (scrape-off layer plus divertor). No registered region token denotes that complete region: scrape_off_layer excludes the divertor contribution, divertor_region excludes the SOL, and edge_region denotes the confined edge rather than the volume outside the LCFS. Using any of them would drop or change the source-stated spatial extent, so no faithful single-locus name can be composed.
